body: Release Focus membership p95 for one project/one pin: 206.23 to 0.25 ms at 1,000 cards; 1,811.91 to 0.35 ms at 10,000 cards (20 samples, application only). A small partial pin index prevents scanning unrelated card metadata; the actual query plan is checked. Full gate and release session/Focus suites pass. Existing manual app rebuilt/restarted and HTTPS verified; all 18 resource versions, pins, settings and certificate preserved. Mixed durable write p95 remains 322.77 ms; creation median remains about 320 ms, dominated by secure filesystem observations/reference rechecks. Keep those guards and stop before introducing an authoritative cache or filesystem rewrite. Detailed limits and all measurements: progress/2026-09-29-three-pass-plan.md. Final bounded audit remains next; acceptance unchanged.
